{{Otheruses|Dark side}}
The '''''Dark Side Compendium''''' was intended to be the seminal work on all matters concerning the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Started by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] shortly after his resurrection in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the Compendium was intended to span hundreds of volumes as Palpatine himself intended never to die. However, he only finished two, with a third manuscript by the time of his [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]].<ref name="DSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> Some ideas that became part of the three volumes were included in his Dark Side manifesto, ''[[Absolute Power]]'', which also included two other works, ''[[The False War]]'' and ''[[The Useful Bureaucrats]]'' on political manipulation, which he had finished between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

Palpatine permitted some of his more powerful underlings access to the work for study, but this access was tightly controlled. [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], a fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and an Imperial [[High Inquisitor]], was allowed to read the ''Compendium'', and from its volumes developed the idea of establishing a coterie of [[Seven Dark Jedi|seven]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] bound to his will. When Palpatine began to distrust his henchman's ambitions, he withdrew Jerec's access to the ''Compendium''.<ref name="Saga3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050512b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 3: Pride of the Dark Side}}</ref>

The three volumes were:
*''[[The Book of Anger]]''
*''[[The Weakness of Inferiors]]''
*''[[The Creation of Monsters]]''
